svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: BNO08x: SPI
svg.desc: Schematic of the BNO08x spi: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 100 nF, R3 resistor 10 kΩ, R4 resistor 4.7 kΩ, R5 resistor 4.7 kΩ, Y1 crystal 32.768 kHz; the MCU wires carry the port hooks IntAsserted(), TakeIntTimestamp(), SetBootn(), SetReset(), SetWake(), SpiTransfer(), transport hooks.
svg.text: The BNO08x on an MCU's SPI bus (PS1 and PS0 high at reset). PS0 is the WAKE pin afterwards, so it is on a GPIO the driver drives through SetWake();
H_INTN and NRST are on GPIOs too. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 1.2.4 SPI Interface, p. 17.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R4 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus; R5 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus.
